postCreateCommand.npm-install-root: echo '=== npm install (ルート / nx など共通ツール) ===' && npm install
postCreateCommand.npm-install-web: echo '=== npm install (clients/web / Next.js 本体) ===' && cd clients/web && npm install
postCreateCommand.gh-extensions-install: echo '=== gh extensions install ===' && gh extension install yahsan2/gh-sub-issue
postCreateCommand.claude-code: echo '=== Claude Code (native install) ===' && curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash && "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" --version
postCreateCommand.message: echo 'Next.js の開発コンテナが起動し、セットアップを実行中...'
